Quick & Simple

How HostelAdda Works

Built from scratch for university students who want hot food delivered without leaving the hostel.

01

Pick Your Campus & Hostel

Select your university (COMSATS, Abasyn or Hostel City) and enter your hostel building or gate point.

02

Select Favorite Meals

Choose from student-priced biryani, burgers, shawarma, karahi, and midnight karak chai from top campus cafes.

03

Collect at Gate & Pay COD

Our student rider delivers to your hostel turnstile in 15-25 minutes. Pay cash or EasyPaisa upon arrival.
